theorems.name: Submission.cone_current_apply_dilation_pullback
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), IsConeCurrent C → ∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, ∃ ω' : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, (∀ y, (ω' : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y = (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (lam⁻¹ • y)) ∧ C ω' = C ω
